top_signals.title: Microsoft sees some new wrinkles in invoice-scam emails
top_signals.summary: Researchers analyzed a flood of fraudulent business emails and found that the threat actors had doubled-up on tactics to make them appear legitimate, including help from AI.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
